# Samuele Bovo

**Animal Genetics · Bioinformatics · Computational Biology**

Assistant Professor in Animal Genetics  
University of Bologna, Italy

**Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Postdoctoral Global Fellow — ABPhenomics**

My background is in bioinformatics and systems biology, including computational methods for molecular interaction networks and omics data integration.

My research spans animal genetics and genomics, from the genetic architecture of complex traits and pig metabolomics and phenomics to population genomics, biodiversity and molecular traceability.

Depending on the research question, I develop computational methods, integrate omics datasets, or apply statistical and machine learning approaches to biological data.

:::

## Research Areas

Exploring animal genomes, molecular phenotypes and biological diversity through genomic, multi-omics and computational approaches.

::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}
<span class="research-number">01</span>

### [Genomics & Molecular Phenotypes](research.qmd#genomics-molecular-phenotypes)

Investigating the genetic architecture of intermediate phenotypes through genome-wide association studies and the integration of genomic, metabolomic, haematological and biochemical data.
:::

::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">02</span>

### [Metabolomics, Phenomics & Machine Learning](research.qmd#metabolomics-phenomics-machine-learning)

Exploring molecular phenotypes, metabolic biomarkers and physiological variability using high-throughput metabolomics, computational methods and machine learning.
:::

::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">03</span>

### [Genomics of Complex & Production Traits](research.qmd#genomics-complex-production-traits)

Dissecting the genetic basis of complex traits affecting animal production, morphology, performance and product quality in livestock and aquaculture species.
:::

::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">04</span>

### [Population Genomics & Biodiversity](research.qmd#population-genomics-biodiversity)

Investigating genetic diversity, population structure, signatures of selection and evolutionary processes to support the characterization and conservation of animal genetic resources.
:::

::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">05</span>

### [Environmental DNA, Metagenomics & One Health](research.qmd#environmental-dna-metagenomics-one-health)

Applying environmental DNA and metagenomic approaches to biodiversity monitoring, pathogen and virome characterization, and DNA-based food authentication.
:::

::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">06</span>

### [Bioinformatics, Systems Biology & Genome Interpretation](research.qmd#bioinformatics-systems-biology)

Developing and applying computational approaches for biological network analysis, functional enrichment, genome interpretation and genetic variant prioritization.
:::

:::

:::
